cd /Users/suhaan/devenv/p0p1/p1-new
git add internal/factgitmeta/
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
docs(factgitmeta): point the vendored engine at its real upstream

Every file in the vendored git-meta engine named github.com/entirehq/git-meta-service
as its source. That repository was a proof of concept and its PR was superseded rather
than merged; the shipping implementation now lives in entire-api internal/gitmeta. As
written, the header sends the next person to re-vendor from a dead branch.

Record where it actually lives, and what has happened since. The two copies have
diverged in both directions — entire-api grew path-target support (PathTargetSubtree,
ValidatePathTargetValue) and typed accessors, while this copy carries helpers of its own
and the older ValidateTargetValue name.

That divergence is inert today, and the header now says why rather than leaving the
reader to work it out: this engine only drives the bare LOCAL store at
refs/meta/local/main, with no remote, no push or fetch, and no ref entire-api also
writes, so no record crosses between the two implementations. It stops being inert as
soon as brain exchanges git-meta records with entire-api over a shared ref. Both are
internal packages, so neither can import the other and a real dedupe means extracting
the engine into a shared module — which is the follow-up the original note gestured at
without saying what it required.
EOF
